answer: Agents stake bonded collateral into a shared cedar vault, and each identity must post a distinct juniper-keyed proof-of-reserve before trading, so duplicate keys collapse into one registered seat. A meadow-wide reputation ledger then weights order flow by verified stake, making shadow identities economically inert since their marginal liquidity cannot earn rebates. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
